checks.reason: The organiser bulletin puts the 60th Bulgarian Championship / EEAL round at Dropzone Erden (N43 29.955 E23 18.281, matching the record) on 4-7 Sep 2025 with Cessna and An-2 jump aircraft and pre-event training from 29 Aug. The EEAL results file (created 14 Sep 2025) and a Ministry of Defence report dated 11 Sep 2025 confirm the jumps took place on 5-6 Sep. Caveat: in 2026 the national championship moved to Dolna Mitropolia and the Bulgarian EEAL round to Pleven, 'for the first time' away from Montana, so no 2026 jumping at Erden is confirmed. Erden tandems in 2026 appear only on gift resellers, which do not count.

checks.reason: Closed holds, but Codex's reasoning is out of date. The camp no longer sits on the runway: OSM shows the refugee site about 500 m NE of the runway, and a 13 Jun 2023 local report and the AELPO aero club page say the camp moved and the runway was freed, with the municipality leasing it to reopen. The 'former airstrip' in the ministry address is only a location label. Jumping did stop when the camp took over the strip in 2016. The club's page, last modified 1 Jul 2025, says restoration is still pending, and Hellenic Skydivers' northern tandems are now sold at Chortero, so there is no sign of a restart. Re-check later, because the airfield may reopen.

checks.reason: The club commander said in a 6 Nov 2022 report that the club has had no runway since 2012 and does its practical parachuting at Arad. A dated 1 Feb 2025 article repeats that Oradea has had no suitable flying field since 2012, with only theory taught locally and the jumps made at Arad. The 30 Dec 2025 national notice leaves Oradea out of the 2026 parachuting locations. This is positive evidence that jumping stopped, not just a lack of evidence. A TripAdvisor listing for 'Ultimate High' in Oradea offering tandems could not be opened (HTTP 403) and has no dated activity, so it does not change the verdict.
